# TaxBrain

> Indian tax intelligence platform for salaried professionals. 100% client-side, zero backend, privacy-first. Built with Astro + React Islands.

## About
- [Home](https://tax.akanksha.dev/): Dashboard with tax summary and recommendations
- [Source](https://github.com/): Open-source on GitHub (MIT licensed)

## Features
- Dual Regime Tax Calculator (New vs Old, FY 2026-27)
- Salary Structure Optimizer (NPS, meal vouchers, phone reimbursement)
- Multi-Job Income Combiner (for job switchers)
- Interactive Scenario Simulator with break-even finder
- Knowledge Base (15+ articles on Indian tax concepts)
- Personalized Action Tracker

## Pages
- [Dashboard](https://tax.akanksha.dev/): At-a-glance tax situation
- [Calculator](https://tax.akanksha.dev/calculator/): Full interactive tax calculator
- [Simulator](https://tax.akanksha.dev/simulator/): What-if scenario analysis
- [Knowledge Base](https://tax.akanksha.dev/knowledge/): Tax concepts explained
- [Actions](https://tax.akanksha.dev/actions/): Tax-saving action checklist

## Technical
- Framework: Astro (latest) + React (Islands Architecture)
- Language: TypeScript (strict)
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages (free, unlimited bandwidth)
- Data: localStorage only (zero backend, zero data sent to servers)
- Tax Engine: Pure TypeScript functions, framework-agnostic
- Tax Law: Income Tax Act, 2025 (effective April 1, 2026)
